description: Fork of exp026 swapping BitPermutationLUT/BitMultiHeadLUT (K=1) for MultiBitPermutationLUT/MultiBitMultiHeadLUT (K=4 midrise quant). Trade-off: halve both tph and output_nap (Q/K, V, out_proj) for 4× fewer bit latents (138M → 35M); each vote carries 4× more info; nominally info-matched. K=4 scale convention auto-set in wrappers; manual scale 0.5/(8·√votes_per_pair) for joint Q/K. Midrise quantization: latents at q=0 effectively contribute +1/16 (DC absorbed by output_bias); init_std=0.001 unchanged because midrise has no q=0 dead zone.
